game.name: Geometry Wars 3: Dimensions
game.desc: Native 32-bit ARM port of the Android version of Geometry Wars 3: Dimensions, running the original libgwnext.so engine through a custom Android-on-Linux loader (KMS/DRM, GLES2, FMOD). Runs 1.3.0 Evolved with its console menus. Supply your own APK and OBB.
